question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

He **is sleeping** when I called him.
solution:
The correct answer is '**was sleeping**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The verb phrase "**was sleeping**" is in the past continuous tense, which is used to describe an action that was ongoing at a particular time in the past.
